labels.annulus_policy: (5,8) ignored; registration residual is unknown, not asserted to equal3px
labels.candidate_policy: row argmax including no-match; raw best SAR candidate also saved; no mutual/threshold filtering for dense query labels
labels.ambiguity_margin: best frozen logit within5px of GT minus best frozen logit at least8px from GT; diagnostic only
labels.ignore: GT outside eroded valid region; no valid positive candidate; error tolerance annulus; invalid optical query
labels.supervision: geometric_correctness only; no weighted blend with ambiguity

head.input: detached optical coarse64 plus masked SAR coarse GAP64; no cross-image correlation input
head.checkpoint_rule: last of fixed12epochs; never select on952 validation

coverage.utility: mean top8 score, softmax over cells; capped Hamilton allocation

teacher.best_metric: fixed64 grayscale pooled seven-class mIoU, same rule forTR/TG; retain earlier on ties
teacher.augmentation: saved native512 crop only; TR RGB vsTG PIL grayscale repeatedRGB; no other augmentation
teacher.weights_release: neither original nor derived weights published while license unresolved

fold_tolerances.policy: predeclared; never relax after seeing results; only gate-passed copy timed as an optimization
